Food Safety Guidelines for Storing Leftovers

Handling and Storage:
- Refrigerate leftovers within two hours of cooking to prevent bacterial growth.
- Divide large portions of food into smaller amounts to facilitate faster cooling.
- Place the food in shallow containers rather than deep ones, as this increases the surface area and allows the food to cool more quickly and evenly in the refrigerator.

Cooking and Reheating:
- When reheating leftovers, ensure they reach an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) before serving to kill any potential bacteria.
